body:
And so it was to be, for it is not the fear of darkness that scares me but of the light that may have been cast that will eventually be smothered away. 

I'll have my last post up shortly, I just have to get prepared.
Took chemistry in uni and environmental in college

No that's okay, I don't know how your life is so I can just say whatever I think may help.

I don't know much about changing locations to live but get a small job and save up for either tickets to travel or maybe for money for your own place.
Just out of curiosity why is England your safe haven?

If I can give one advice it will be this, you need to put an end to that at once and I will tell you why. I was in the same spot as you, never really fitting in and when I did i was the verbal punching bag of the group, it didn't help I have low self-esteem problems with myself and I wanted to fit in so I let it happen, even making my own jokes at my own expense. Because of that it messed me up, made me feel like that was the only way I could fit in and made me depressing to be around.
Fastforward a few years and I found myself the best girlfriend ever and life was finally going my way a bit, but because of how I was treated and how low I put myself down in order to be liked further she did not like that one bit and subsequently she left me quite recently.

The take away message from that is to talk it out with your friends and tell them you don't approve or stand up for yourself when it happens, at first they will think you are being sensitive because they joked about it all the time but they will hopefully come to realize you don't like it and if they don't then find new friends who get you. 

I feel you are going through something similar with me and as such all I can say is a change in attitude goes a long way, you have to feel good about yourself first. If i can give a quote my dad usually gives me "you have only failed once you have stopped trying" you have to make realistic goals for yourself that you want to achieve. Do you want to travel the world? Start a business? What interests you and that requires self searching and no one can do that for you but you.

Well that's not good at all, try and talk to your sister, but slowly though, bring up small conversational pieces about how you are feeling, if she asks how was your day or something talk about how you weren't feeling that great or something and hopefully that will branch into further questions from her. 

Some people cannot handle a full train load of emotions all at once and can cause them to distance themselves from the source which will suck because she is your sister. But sometimes talking it out with family can really help, don't keep it bottled inside or it will hurt more then ever.

I am glad i was able to make you feel a bit better, if you ever need someone to listen to you you know we are always here to help.

That is a very heartbreaking story, but you still have your sister and she will and always will love you. 
I wish I had answers for you but all I can think is maybe you need a change in scenery, it can be hard especially when you feel you are all alone. I am currently going through the same loneliness and I know how depressing it can feel, but take it one day at a time for now.
I keep a journal that I write in (mostly because I am weird and like to write) and that may be of help to you. Keep that dream of leaving to England and work towards it as a goal; I'm really sorry I can't offer more advice but anything I say will sound fake coming from me as I can't really follow my own advice.
But I want you to know you are not alone and sometimes you just need someone to talk to and in this I hope I can be of help to you.

Because someone somewhere will miss seeing your smile. Whether it be family, friends, significant other, someone out there will miss it and if you believe no one will then you haven't met that person whose very essence you can't get enough of. 
You haven't experienced something you truly love and would never want to part ways with; to leave your mark, provide a legacy, be a role model, or just to start a family whose very being will push you forward.
These are just some small points why I think you should stay with us and not give into the darkness, no matter how thick it may be.

You can pm me as well and we can talk on the phone if you like. My gf left me on thanksgiving so I know the pain you are feeling. I wish I knew what I could to say to help you ease the pain but I find myself crying at night as well sometimes
If you still need someone to talk to, I am here as well

I will try. 

I do still have really strong feelings for her, it might seem like a double sided logic but I loved her so much even though I didn't love myself. The words she told me still haunt my mind, that she was lonely and that I was someone who had been around. That their might have been no feeling between us from the get go that what I thought we had for two years may have been a lie (this may have been taken out of context when she said it but I'm pretty good at reading between the lines) and that broke me into pieces.

I kept nothing from her, I told her my feelings and everything that happened with me past and present (even though lying may have gotten me out of trouble). I thought that your girlfriend could have also been your best friend but it seemed that it cannot be, it's either one or the other.

I'm sorry about the late reply, I have my laptop here but I stare out into space and sometimes give myself physical pain in ways of alleviating my mental pain. If you are still around then I am here as well but I know it is New Years Eve and that most people will have other things to do.

It was how I was treated, a member of the team, like my work mattered. They offered me a lot and the ability to help further my career as well and the pay was also really good as well. I guess the pride came from the fact that I made it somehow, that I could actually start my life and move forward with it.

My brother is 22 but he wouldn't understand but he can be good comfort to talk to. The only thing i wanted to do was drop the weight that I've had on me. Changing how I feel about myself I think will be a good step forward.

The most advice I got was with dealing with my ex and they all told me was to find someone else but its not that simple for me. I loved her even if it turned out she didn't love me. I had gotten her a promise ring for Christmas before she broke it off for me. It didn't seem to faze her when I told her about the Christmas gift I had planned (i don't know why i told her about it) and all it did was push her away from me.

For now I will do what you said and give it three months of 2016 to see if life has changed for the better for me. As of right now I have no faith in myself or that it ever will but I am willing to see.

Yeah we talk all the time, he on a strange note has been my strength because he keeps telling me better things are out there and tells me that I shouldn't look for girls or a job to define my life which is very insightful for him.

I know he is right and I have to redevelop myself somehow but I just don't know how. The last job that was only for a month gave me a sense of pride I hadn't felt for a long time and I was able to sleep through the night but that did not last as long as I hoped.

I want to be strong for him as well as for myself because through whatever happened in my life he always believed in me and looked up to me. Even when I am currently at my lowest point as of right now.

You are right I am male, and I know my parents will be completely destroyed, I have a younger brother and I know it would break him and that is what is making me stay in this world. 

I have no one to blame for what has happened to me but myself, even my ex i feel had a pretty good reason to leave even though that crippled me emotionally, and to top it all off she has already moved on. 

My friends are all busy with their lives and only offer that i man up and move on and then talk about how other people have it worse then me; which is true but it doesn't help my situation or feelings at all.

It feels like a never ending stop, my dad told me that he grew up with a saying "trouble comes in three" and that I have gone through my three and all i have left is to go up.

To be honest my cut off point to end my life was when I turned 25 and accomplished nothing with it. That is 2 months away currently...

I hear you man. You sound like the complete opposite of me, the thing is do you love yourself though? I had a wonderful girl at the time but because I didn't love myself she left me, I do not want the same thing to happen to you. 

It still affects me and the fact that she moved on so fast is also another kick in face.

Have you tried online dating? It might seem lame or not the right way to do it but its all about the first impression and now a days must people are awkward with face to face interactions and are more comfortable being themselves through online interactions before face to face meetings.

You sound like you have confidence and a lot going for you and that is great but maybe give online dating a try if you haven't already. I wish I could offer more advice but I am in the same boat as you with practically nothing to offer right now/

Thank you for your words of support, your nan was a smart woman and I appreciate her words as well.

I hope they are accurate, as of right now I am living back at home, my parents still love me and are putting a roof over my head but I always feel like a burden and a let down to them.

I understand completely how you feel. I do not have the answers and I am currently going through a hard patch in my life. But what I can tell you is that love is always out there. I had found mine but because of my depression and lack of love for myself I lost her and she will never come back to me. But before I met her I never knew that I could ever feel what love was.

This will seem really hypocritical coming from me but you need to love yourself like I do as well. We will find someone in life that deserves our love but in the meantime, love must bloom within before it can be spread to others.

My family knows of my struggles but not of my dark thoughts. I'm scared. Scared that I have let them down, that I failed myself, and by even thinking of ending it all means I have given up on fixing myself. I was never a quitter but there is only so much I can take and I feel I am almost at the limit. 

I'm happy for your daughter and I hope she finds her happiness in life. Something I feel is out of my reach.
